CLAUSES.title: Assurance scope set by actual reliance
CLAUSES.statement: Evidence engineering SHALL operate from inception for SOC 1 (AT-C 320, ledger and ICFR objectives) and SOC 2 (2017 Trust Services Criteria, 2022 points of focus) readiness, with complementary user entity controls mapped. Before live reliance by a sponsor, the sponsor's external auditor's written planned approach (rely on a SOC 1 type 2, test Unbound directly, or substantive testing) SHALL be recorded and SHALL set report scope and timing; no sponsor-count trigger and no stand-alone type 1 SHALL be required unless a contract requires it. A SOC 1 type 2 covering a full period SHALL be planned once any user auditor plans to rely on Unbound controls or two or more user entities exist. Contracts SHALL include right-to-audit, an evidence pack and a named cost bearer (default: each party bears its own auditor and staff costs). Manual review procedures SHALL be replaced by continuous or generated evidence only after the auditor confirms reliance; generated reports SHALL carry information-produced-by-entity support (query definition, parameters, population counts, hash, run log).
acceptance_criteria: Given a sponsor without a recorded auditor planned approach, when production reliance is requested, then activation is refused.
Given a generated close certification, when produced, then it includes population counts, query hash and run log.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor external auditor's written planned approach; executed contract assurance clause.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor external auditor's written planned approach; executed contract assurance clause.

CLAUSES.title: Vendor reports and bridge letters
CLAUSES.statement: Vendor assurance monitoring SHALL compute the gap between each relevant SOC report period end and each relying party's fiscal year-end or reliance date; a bridge letter SHALL be requested at a configurable gap (3-month default labelled practice, not standard) and a stale-report alert raised at 12 months; bridge letters SHALL be recorded as management assertions that do not extend assurance; beyond the tolerance, compensating procedures or a time-limited risk acceptance SHALL be required; coverage gaps, opinion modifications, exceptions and unmapped CUECs SHALL be tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vendor report ending 30 June and a sponsor fiscal year ending 31 December, when monitoring runs on 1 October, then a bridge letter request is due.
Given an adverse opinion, when recorded, then a risk acceptance or compensating procedure is required before continued reliance.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor external auditor confirms the tolerance used in its reliance.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor external auditor confirms the tolerance used in its reliance.

CLAUSES.title: Segregation of duties with deterministic release
CLAUSES.statement: Segregation of duties SHALL be enforced by the engine. The deterministic release gate SHALL count as the releaser only when it runs a published, independently approved policy version, the human approvers have no authoring, publishing, deployment or administration rights over it, ITGCs are effective, and the external auditor and board or audit committee have accepted the design; until then the three-distinct-person rule SHALL apply. Reconciliation SHALL be performed outside the payment chain (internal or outsourced, chosen by cost) with daily automated matching, prompt exception review and at least monthly independent review. Enforced leave SHALL apply where at least two trained staff exist, anomaly analytics otherwise; the CISO SHALL have direct access to the audit and risk committee; independent review SHALL be required for key and manual controls; each alternative control SHALL be documented with expiry.
acceptance_criteria: Given an approver who also has deploy rights to the gate, when they approve a PA-2 resolution, then the system requires a third distinct person.
Given an alternative control past its expiry, when the control register runs, then it is flagged for committee review.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: External auditor acceptance of the SoD design; board or audit committee approval.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: External auditor acceptance of the SoD design; board or audit committee approval.

CLAUSES.title: Appointed contracted and fractional authority holders
CLAUSES.statement: Reserved (A3+) authority SHALL be exercisable only by persons appointed by sponsor board resolution as officers or authorized agents with scope by decision class and limit, start and expiry, independence and conflict attestations, D&O or indemnification confirmation and acknowledgment of §4958 and §4966 manager status; contracted and fractional individuals MAY be appointed. Unbound vendor staff SHALL NOT hold A3+ authority. No person SHALL hold reserved authority for more than one sponsor (SPD-ADV-001); team transfers SHALL revoke old access before granting new access. Coverage SHALL be stated as roster coverage by role and day, derived from criticality, peak workload and independence, with double absence tested as a December stress scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Given an appointment record without expiry, when saved, then it is rejected.
Given a person appointed by sponsor A, when sponsor B attempts to appoint them for A3 decisions, then the appointment is refused.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor board resolution of appointment; bylaws permitting additional officers.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor board resolution of appointment; bylaws permitting additional officers.

CLAUSES.title: Death, succession, representatives and protective suspension
CLAUSES.statement: On credible notice of an advisor's death the platform SHALL hold new actions by that person; on verification it SHALL suspend only that person's privileges; succession SHALL start only when no living, qualified advisor remains. Successor allocations SHALL create one new fund per successor by percentage (cents rounding, remainder per sponsor rule) with a successor-response window (default 90 days after documented notice, configurable 90–365) and at least three contact attempts through every verified channel; nonresponse SHALL route to the sponsor's configured default. Approved unpaid grants SHALL proceed unless sponsor policy says otherwise. An agent under a power of attorney MAY exercise advisory privileges only if program terms permit representatives, the instrument is acknowledged and verified and it expressly grants gift or charitable authority (or references the advisory privileges); conservators act only under a court order specifically authorizing the act; guardians of the person have no authority; otherwise the instrument SHALL be treated as evidence of incapacity. A presented power of attorney SHALL be answered within 7 business days (accept, request certification or refuse on a listed ground). Protective suspension of a representative SHALL rest on program terms: trigger is reasonable belief of exploitation; up to 15 business days, one 10-business-day extension after documented independent review, and up to 30 further business days only after a report to adult protective services, law enforcement, a regulator or a court; notice within 2 business days unless it would endanger the principal; expiry without escalation SHALL release or convert to a recorded sponsor decision.
acceptance_criteria: Given two co-advisors and one verified death, when the survivor recommends a grant, then it proceeds under the survivor's recorded authority.
Given a presented POA with no gift authority, when reviewed, then the response within 7 business days is a refusal citing the listed ground and succession review is opened.
Given a protective suspension at day 15 with no independent review, when the deadline passes, then it is released or converted with a recorded decision.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor-approved program terms on succession, dormancy, representatives and protective suspension.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor-approved program terms on succession, dormancy, representatives and protective suspension.

CLAUSES.title: Disputes, exits, bulk transfers and records custody
CLAUSES.statement: During a fund dispute freeze fees SHALL accrue and be collected (waiver is a separate decision), investments SHALL follow the standing policy including scheduled rebalancing, advisor-directed allocation changes and grants SHALL be held, contributions accepted, and no distribution or transfer made until the sponsor resolves the dispute or a court orders otherwise. Sponsor-initiated bulk transfers and partner-exit transfers SHALL be executed fund by fund as separate sponsor-authorized grants under a written exit policy and master agreement, each with eligibility, sanctions and hold checks; the sponsor MAY decline or condition individual transfers; a Schedule N flag SHALL be raised when the series exceeds 25% of net assets and a state attorney-general notice check when substantially all assets move. Fees and deadlines SHALL be disclosed and SHALL NOT make lawful transfer effectively impossible. The sponsor SHALL be records custodian; after exit the platform SHALL keep a read-only copy 90 days after the sponsor confirms the reconciled export, backups SHALL expire no later than 35 days after that, legal holds SHALL override, held funds SHALL NOT transfer and read-only access SHALL persist until holds lift, and an exit certificate SHALL list residuals.
acceptance_criteria: Given an exit while an investigation hold exists on fund F, when the exit runs, then F is not transferred and remains readable.
Given transfers totalling 30% of net assets, when the series completes, then a Schedule N flag is recorded.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Executed master agreement; board-adopted exit policy; contract clause on custody and exit.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Executed master agreement; board-adopted exit policy; contract clause on custody and exit.

CLAUSES.title: Regulatory perimeter: no custody, no unilateral payment control, no advice
CLAUSES.statement: Unbound SHALL NOT receive or hold donor or grant money (no operator, FBO or pooled accounts), SHALL NOT be able to execute or indefinitely prevent a payment unilaterally, and donor payments SHALL settle directly into sponsor-owned accounts through regulated processors; a funds-flow conformance check SHALL verify each deployment against these tests and SHALL block activation where they fail (licensing or a licensed partner would then be required). Unbound SHALL NOT provide operator-authored fund- or donor-specific recommendations on securities or allocations, construct models, select managers, route orders for others' accounts, take compensation varying with assets, trades or liquidations, or hold custody; implementing sponsor-selected models executed by the sponsor's custodian and factual, non-evaluative reporting are permitted. Pools SHALL rely on Investment Company Act §3(c)(10)(B) with §7(e) donor disclosure; release 1 SHALL be single-sponsor pools only (multi-sponsor pools are lawful but deferred); no per-donation compensation SHALL be paid to solicitors. Customer identification program rules SHALL NOT be assumed to apply; risk-based identity proofing and OFAC compliance SHALL apply.
acceptance_criteria: Given a deployment configuration that routes contributions to an Unbound-controlled account, when activation is requested, then it fails the funds-flow conformance check.
Given an AI feature proposing a donor-specific allocation change, when invoked, then it is refused with AdviceNotPermitted.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: None for conforming deployments; SEC/state adviser or broker-dealer registration, or a money-transmission licence or licensed partner, only if prohibited features are ever enabled.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: None for conforming deployments; SEC/state adviser or broker-dealer registration, or a money-transmission licence or licensed partner, only if prohibited features are ever enabled.

CLAUSES.title: California charitable fundraising platform registration
CLAUSES.statement: Unbound SHALL register with the California Attorney General's Registry of Charities and Fundraisers as a charitable fundraising platform before activating white-label, embedded, direct-to-consumer own-brand or charity-side donation features for California users, and SHALL meet the associated disclosure and recordkeeping duties. Sponsor-direct deployments where charity listings are visible only to advisory-privileged users on the sponsor's own branded platform MAY launch in California with records evidencing sponsor ownership and branding (interpretation, moderate confidence). Referral compensation SHALL remain disabled until each compensated referrer is registered where it solicits and the arrangement passes §4958 and Exchange Act §3(e)(2) review.
acceptance_criteria: Given no recorded registration, when a white-label sponsor enables California donors, then activation is refused with CaliforniaPlatformRegistrationRequired.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Operator registration with the California Attorney General Registry as a charitable fundraising platform.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Operator registration with the California Attorney General Registry as a charitable fundraising platform.

CLAUSES.title: Communications law classification and consent
CLAUSES.statement: Every message template SHALL be classified commercial, transactional or relationship, or other (16 CFR 316.3) before activation, including email; promotional DAF email SHALL receive commercial controls with the sponsor as sender in white-label programs, and a single designated sender only where 316.2(m) is met; suppression SHALL be keyed to the sender and opt-outs honored within 10 business days across all platforms that send for that sender. Automated or prerecorded texts and calls SHALL require prior express written consent naming the sponsor (and any for-profit partner advertised); revocation SHALL follow the FCC rules effective 25 November 2026; residential prerecorded calls SHALL be limited to 3 per 30 days with a company-specific do-not-call list.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unclassified template, when activation is requested, then it is refused.
Given an SMS opt-out reply, when received, then all future automated texts for that sender stop and the revocation is evidenced.

CLAUSES.title: Call recording disabled with a consent design for later
CLAUSES.statement: Release 1 SHALL NOT record or machine-transcribe calls. When enabled, recording SHALL require an outset disclosure to every party, affirmative consent (keypad or verbal), a no-recording path, re-disclosure and consent for any party joining later (or pausing for that segment), transfer events with consent status, and a transcription vendor contracted as a service provider without training or independent use; the uniform strictest rule SHALL apply, with a jurisdiction table kept for review.
acceptance_criteria: Given a call transferred to a third party while recording is enabled, when the party joins, then recording pauses until consent is captured.

CLAUSES.title: Identity proofing, authentication and contact assurance
CLAUSES.statement: Donor and advisor identity proofing SHALL be risk-based: validate core attributes against authoritative sources, match the funding account owner and confirm a validated address or phone; step up to document and selfie or a non-biometric live-video alternative when validation fails or risk is elevated; entities SHALL be verified by registration and signatory authority. Knowledge-based verification SHALL NOT be used for proofing and SHALL never exceed contact assurance level CAL1. Platform and sponsor privileged roles SHALL use AAL3-grade authenticators (hardware keys or device-bound non-exportable keys; no synced passkeys) with two keys per user and identity-proofed recovery; other workforce SHALL use AAL2 phishing-resistant authenticators. Contact assurance SHALL use distinct levels CAL0–CAL3, with only CAL3 mapped to an achieved AAL. Verified prefill SHALL be marked as prefill, require confirmation, never overwrite verified data silently, and never substitute for identity proofing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a caller verified only by knowledge questions, when they request a bank-detail change, then it is refused below CAL3.
Given a privileged sponsor user with a synced passkey, when they attempt to approve a reserved decision, then step-up to an AAL3 authenticator is required.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor bank confirmation that its agreement imposes no stricter KYC.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor bank confirmation that its agreement imposes no stricter KYC.

CLAUSES.title: Retention classes
CLAUSES.statement: Transaction-level financial records (contributions, grants, rejected or declined sanctioned transactions) and related screening results, dispositions and licence reliance records SHALL be retained 10 years after the transaction date; records about blocked property while blocked plus 10 years after unblocking; other financial and grant records at least 7 years; sponsor organizing documents and determination letters permanently; ACH authorizations per CNV-PAY-005. Legal holds SHALL override disposition. The sponsor compliance owner SHALL approve the schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Given a grant paid on 1 March 2026, when disposition is evaluated on 2 March 2035, then the record is retained.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor compliance owner approval of the retention schedule.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor compliance owner approval of the retention schedule.

CLAUSES.title: Statements and complaints
CLAUSES.statement: Statements SHALL be generated for every configured period; the default notification SHALL be a quarterly digest plus correction alerts, monthly by opt-in, paper on request or absent electronic consent, and any cadence promised in program terms SHALL override defaults (no statutory periodic-statement duty was found). A complaint SHALL mean any expression of dissatisfaction, justified or not; acknowledgment within 2 business days, substantive response target 15 business days, outer limit 60 calendar days with a holding response; regulator-originated complaints SHALL route to the sponsor's legal function within 1 business day; contractual or legal deadlines SHALL override.
acceptance_criteria: Given a donor without e-consent, when the quarter closes, then a paper statement is queued.
Given a complaint unresolved at day 15, when the target passes, then a holding response is sent and the case escalates.
